skillMdInspector.general.timeFormat.description: Time format for the "Generated" timestamp shown in generated reports. "european" uses a 24-hour clock; "usa" uses a 12-hour clock with AM/PM.

skillMdInspector.validation.enabled.description: Enable deterministic validation of SKILL.md files.

skillMdInspector.validation.runOnSave.description: Re-run validation whenever a SKILL.md file is saved.

skillMdInspector.body.strictness.description: How strictly to surface advisory body-section recommendations (examples, when-to-use, etc.). "off" disables them; "recommended" uses information-level diagnostics; "strict" uses warnings. Structural body errors are unaffected.

skillMdInspector.description.language.description: Language used by description heuristics. "en" forces English analysis; "auto" marks the quality score as language-limited when it detects a non-Latin script (Cyrillic, CJK, …) or a common Latin-script language (German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese) via stopword profiles. Other languages may still be scored as English.

skillMdInspector.description.maxLength.description: Maximum allowed length of the description field.

skillMdInspector.description.minLength.description: Minimum recommended length of the description field.

skillMdInspector.name.maxLength.description: Maximum allowed length of the name field.

skillMdInspector.collision.boundarySepar.description: How strongly mutually-exclusive "Do not use for..." boundaries reduce the composite collision score (0 = ignore boundaries, 1 = fully cancel overlap when scopes are mutually excluded).

skillMdInspector.collision.ngramSize.description: Character n-gram size used by the collision character-similarity metric.

skillMdInspector.collision.threshold.description: Composite similarity (0–1) at or above which two skills are reported as a potential collision.

skillMdInspector.collision.weights.description: Relative weights blended into the composite collision score. Normalized to sum to 1 at runtime, so only the ratios matter.

skillMdInspector.names.similarityThresho.description: Similarity (0–1) at or above which two different skill names are flagged as confusingly similar. Exact duplicates are always reported.

skillMdInspector.heuristics.dictionaryVa.description: Acronyms and technology names recognized as concrete artifact or domain evidence.
Explicit surface forms for action verbs. Keys are base verbs and values are recognized forms; explicit entries take precedence over regular morphology.
Base verbs recognized as concrete capabilities in description diagnostics, description completeness, local improvement, and collision features.
High-signal artifact and domain terms used by description quality and collision feature extraction.
Domain terms that make a low-signal artifact such as file, data, code, or document concrete.
Common terms removed before workspace description collision similarity is calculated.
Phrases that act as both a positive usage trigger and an exclusive boundary.
Terms ignored when deciding whether the opening sentence names a concrete capability object.
Irregular plural normalization used by artifact matching and collision analysis. Keys are singular bases and values are plural forms.
Generic artifact terms that count only when accompanied by an artifact support term.
Multi-word artifact phrases recognized by description quality and collision feature extraction.
Phrases that introduce a negative usage boundary and separate collision scopes.
Conservative phrases that indicate an overbroad skill-selection scope when used in a usage or trigger context.
Phrases that introduce a positive usage-trigger clause.
Non-negative phrases that restrict scope for boundary detection and scoring.
Terms ignored when evaluating whether trigger and boundary clauses contain concrete scope.
Terms that make trigger and boundary clause content too vague to receive full credit.
Ambiguous acronyms that count only when their matched spelling is uppercase.
Words and phrases treated as vague in description diagnostics and description completeness.
Phrases such as only for or limited to that name the skill scope rather than exclude one; they earn boundary credit in scoring but are not collision exclusions.

skillMdInspector.discovery.exclude.description: Glob patterns for directories to skip when discovering SKILL.md files across the workspace (the tree view and workspace report). Setting this replaces the defaults.

skillMdInspector.resources.directories.description: Relative resource directories monitored for unreferenced bundled files. This replaces the default list; absolute paths and .. traversal are ignored.

skillMdInspector.resources.exclude.description: Glob patterns for files and folders to exclude from resource discovery. Setting this replaces the defaults.

skillMdInspector.links.onlineCheck.enabl.description: Check remote-link availability during full validation. Enabling this sends HTTP requests to URLs referenced by SKILL.md files.

skillMdInspector.links.onlineCheck.maxCo.description: Maximum number of concurrent remote-link requests across one complete validation operation.

skillMdInspector.severityOverrides.markdownDescription:
Override the severity of diagnostics by code, or disable one with `off` (e.g. `{ "skill.description.vague": "information" }`). Specification errors are protected unless `#skillMdInspector.severity.allowSpecificationOverrides#` is enabled.

[Configure with a picker…](command:skillMdInspector.configureSeverityOverrides)

skillMdInspector.severity.allowSpecifica.description: Allow skillMdInspector.severityOverrides to downgrade or disable specification-level errors (an invalid file). Off by default so structural errors are not hidden accidentally.

skillMdInspector.templates.description: Custom SKILL.md templates. A non-empty array replaces the bundled templates.

label.description: Template name displayed in the selection list.

description.description: Optional explanation displayed in the selection list.

frontmatter.description: YAML frontmatter lines without the opening and closing --- delimiters.

body.description: Markdown body lines. Use an empty string to insert a blank line.

skillMdInspector.navigator.additionalRoo.description: Additional local agent roots to show in the Installed Agents view.

skillMdInspector.openCode.maxDiscoveredS.description: Maximum OpenCode session JSON files to discover.

skillMdInspector.openCode.maxPreviewChar.description: Maximum characters retained in OpenCode previews.

skillMdInspector.openCode.maxSessionFile.description: Maximum OpenCode session export file size to read, in MiB.

skillMdInspector.openCode.scanRecursivel.description: Scan the selected OpenCode sessions folder recursively.
